title: Energy source uncertainty
prompt: A board is normally fed from path A, but a coupler and an alternate transfer path exist. Determine what information must be established before treating it as incapable of energisation.

title: UPS abnormal state
prompt: Normal input is unavailable, battery remains connected and bypass availability is uncertain. Separate known sources from unresolved conditions.

title: Same fault, different source
prompt: Compare a downstream fault when supplied from transformer/mains, UPS inverter and bypass. Identify what study or manufacturer information is needed before predicting protection performance.

title: Commissioning configuration
prompt: A temporary load bank and inhibited automatic transfer are present. Reconstruct the current system rather than the design state.

title: Mechanical resilience
prompt: One electrical path is unavailable and an ATS-fed cooling load has transferred. Identify the remaining resilience and operational consequence.

title: Contradictory indication
prompt: Local device state and monitoring indication disagree. Identify what is known, what is not, and the correct stop/challenge response.
